alerts.headline: Coastal Flood Advisory issued October 9 at 1:42PM PDT until October 13 at 2:00PM PDT by NWS San Diego CA
alerts.description:
* WHAT...For the Coastal Flood Warning, significant coastal
flooding and erosion possible. For the Beach Hazards Statement,
surf of 5 to 7 feet with local sets up to 9 feet. For the
Coastal Flood Advisory, minor coastal flooding expected.

* WHERE...San Diego County Coastal Areas and Orange County
Coastal Areas.

* WHEN...For the Coastal Flood Warning, until 3 PM PDT Sunday.
For the Beach Hazards Statement, from Sunday morning through
Sunday evening. For the Coastal Flood Advisory, from 3 PM
Sunday to 2 PM PDT Tuesday.

* IMPACTS...Numerous roads and walking paths may be closed due to
high wat
